posts.title: Photo Challenge: What am I?
posts.summary: This week's challenge: solve the riddle, then make a true photograph of the answer. Submit yours by Monday, November 16.
body: This week's LWZ Photo Challenge starts with a riddle. Read it closely, figure out what it describes, then go out and make the best photograph you can of that idea.
Don't just take a pic. Make a true photograph: think about your light, your composition, and what you want someone to feel when they see it.
list: Solve the riddle on the flyer.
Go out and make your photograph of the answer.
Submit it to the LWZ Google Drive at lightwriterz.org/submit.html by Monday, November 16, 2026.
We will review, critique, and vote on the best photographs together.

posts.title: Welcome, Brianna Cisneros, our new Management Assistant
posts.summary: Members elected Brianna Cisneros as Management Assistant at today's meeting, after a close race between two outstanding candidates.
body: Light Writerz members have elected Brianna Cisneros as our new Management Assistant. The vote was held at today's meeting, and it was a close race.

Both candidates, Brianna Cisneros and Hadasa Sierra, showed the initiative, reliability, and care for the club that this role calls for. Thank you, Hadasa, for stepping forward and putting your name in. LWZ is stronger because members like you are ready to lead.
As Management Assistant, Brianna joins the officer team and will support every officer role, helping wherever LWZ needs it. Congratulations, Brianna!

posts.title: The vote: Management Assistant
posts.summary: Members voted for our new Management Assistant at the October 13 meeting. Here is how the vote worked.
body: The October 13 LWZ meeting included the vote for our new Management Assistant. The nominees were Brianna Cisneros and Hadasa Sierra.
list: Check in first. Scan the meeting check-in QR and tap Mark as Present. Only students on today's attendance can vote.
Wait for the vote to open. Once attendance is taken, the officers open voting and show the voting QR.
Scan the voting QR, enter your 6 digit student number, and choose your candidate.
One vote per student. Your vote is final once you tap Vote.
Ballots stay private. Only the totals are announced.
Voting closed at 1:05 PM, and the new Management Assistant was announced at the meeting.

posts.title: New officer position: Management Assistant
posts.summary: A new officer role that supports the whole team. Nominations are closed, and members vote at today's meeting.
body: The Management Assistant supports the whole officer team, helping any officer in any capacity. One week that might mean helping the President run a meeting; the next, covering for the Vice President, helping the Secretary with attendance and notes, tracking supplies with the Treasurer, gathering photos for the PR / Media Officer, or setting up a project with the Creative Director.
It is a great fit for a member who is reliable, organized, and ready to pitch in wherever LWZ needs it. It is also the best seat in the club for learning how every officer role works.
Members vote at the LWZ meeting on Tuesday, October 13. Nominations are now closed.

posts.title: Meeting check-in goes digital
posts.summary: Members now check in to LWZ meetings by scanning a QR code with their phone.
body: Starting October 6, members check in to LWZ meetings by scanning a QR code with their phone and entering their student number.
Your first check-in builds your LWZ member profile. After that, checking in takes a few seconds.

posts.title: Meet your 2026 / 2027 officers
posts.summary: The votes are in. Leo Rodriguez leads Light Writerz as President, with a full team of student officers ready for the year.
body: The votes are in. Leo Rodriguez leads Light Writerz as President, with Ashley Ortega as Vice President, Mary Rojas as Secretary, Gloria Ramirez as Treasurer, Wendy Linarez Ortuño as Public Relations / Media Officer, and Robert Carter as Creative Director.
